derived_candidates.text: Isamu Mochizuki, Yoshio Shiga, and Satoru Ono were all ace fighter pilots in the Imperial Japanese Navy during World War II, similar to Yoshimi Minami.
The Kamikaze attacks were officially called Tokubetsu Kōgekitai (Special Attack Unit) and were suicide attacks by military aviators.
